_comment: Per-model API prices in US dollars per million tokens, used by research_assistant.estimate_cost. Edit freely: add a model_id with its input_per_mtok and output_per_mtok to get a dollar estimate for it; a model with no entry here is estimated in tokens only (dollars: null). Ollama (local) models are always dollars: 0 and are NOT listed here. Keys beginning with an underscore are ignored. First-party Anthropic API rates, checked 2026-10-19 (Claude Haiku 5.5: prompts up to 100K tokens).
